data.narrative:
Sanctuary AI, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $130M to date, is evaluated against a universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable in the robotics sector. The peer set includes both same-stage and adjacent-stage companies: Exotec and Hadrian (Series D, $1.6B–$2.0B valuations), Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity (Series B, $1.6B–$1.8B valuations).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy base, applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $221M. Peer-median methodology anchors to the 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, which show a median valuation of $1.6B with a range of $1.0B–$2.0B, implying $1.65B for Sanctuary AI.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $188M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $936M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty in how directly peer valuations transfer to Sanctuary AI at Series C. Stage-progression yields conservative guidance; peer-median likely incorporates later-stage premium. Resolution depends on clarity around Sanctuary AI's revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and unit economics relative to the peer cohort.
